digest.component_or_area: RP-02 through RP-06 derisk and approval framework
propositions: Five recovered decision items (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed durable briefs mapping architectural intent, prior hard-won behavior, implementation seams, migration hazards, and remaining maintainer choices before becoming implementation stories.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match binding retirement recovery at the live-operation boundary with fail-closed atomicity; RP-03 owns TicketPlan orchestration and Jira lifecycle failure policy with a scoped finite-pass fuse; neither duplicates persistence recovery.

RP-03 retry policy uses singular adapter ownership with 3 physical wire/subprocess invocations, 15s cumulative sleep, and authoritative Retry-After lower bounds; the scoped fuse opens after 3 consecutive exhausted eligible outcomes across at least 2 tickets.

RP-04 supplies centralized operation-authority with explicit precedence (CLI > environment > project > user > default), per-operation snapshots, and fail-closed malformed-config behavior; RP-05 depends on its cutover seam.

RP-05 normalizes canonical help for all 75 visible top-level commands via stdlib argparse factory and eliminates unsafe handler-owned help like 'enrich --help'; RP-06 receives unified effective-policy snapshots and implements Option-B typed discovery failure handling with explicit 'review-plan --retry' resume semantics.
